approval_required_for: Any change to artifact.input.human_agent_boundary or constraint.human.boundary
Any change to artifact.input.design_space hard_constraints, objectives, or qor_targets
Any major template_library/template_metadata binding override outside the already selected template set
Adopting a planned_tool.<short_name> or planned_checker.<short_name> as an approved workaround for a missing checker-verified capability

executable_actions.on_failure: Block stage_sacg_extraction, record the violated constraint/artifact as an input-preparation blocker in sacg_memory, and return the bounded repair or approval item to the owning specialist; do not rewrite the inputs or bypass the checker.
executable_actions.rationale: The readiness gate must be grounded in checker evidence that template_library/template_metadata bind to the selected design_space and case_adapter, tool_protocols support checker-verified execution, and human_agent_boundary defines approval/forbidden actions without contradictory auto-allowed paths.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep artifact.stage0.input_readiness_gate unapproved, block stage_sacg_extraction, and route each failed invariant back to the responsible specialist with the consumed artifact and checker status; do not aggregate contradictory audit findings into a false ready state.
executable_actions.rationale: The toolchain-boundary audit is necessary but not sufficient; model, numeric/board, and field-evidence specialist findings must be merged into one checker-verified readiness decision before SACG extraction can consume the aggregate.

observations: sacg_memory_truth has active_contamination_barrier_count 0, open_backtrack_request_count 0, and open_retry_request_count 0; therefore no current SACG-memory blockers apply to this input-preparation gate.
No retry_reconciliation_contract was supplied for this stage, so there is no superseding-retry artifact distinction to enforce here.
hierarchical_learning_context is empty/status no_validated_lower_layer_evidence, so no lower-layer hash-bound invariant or timing semantics constrain this stage.

The candidate prepared_inputs slice reports mode independent_from_scratch_design and an empty errors list, which is positive but does not by itself prove template binding, tool protocol, or human-boundary checker status.

The visible candidate outputs include case_adapter, design_space, field_evidence, field_evidence_candidates, and human_agent_boundary; template_library and template_metadata are listed in the state summary but their detailed binding metadata is not visible in this prompt.
tool_protocols is listed as an input artifact, but its checker-verified coverage of the required compile-only VCS roles and the case-adapter acceptance/evidence gates is not visible in this slice.

The parallel specialist audits artifact.stage0.model_input_audit, artifact.stage0.numeric_board_audit, and artifact.stage0.input_evidence_audit are declared as consumed but their detailed pass/fail/blocker statuses are not visible; they must be merged by checker-backed aggregation.
proposed_actions: Run the named static checkers on template_library, template_metadata, design_space, tool_protocols, and human_agent_boundary and record pass/fail/not_run in artifact.stage0.toolchain_boundary_audit.
Consume the peer model_input_audit, numeric_board_audit, and input_evidence_audit outputs together with the toolchain boundary audit and aggregate them into artifact.stage0.input_readiness_gate.
If any tool/template/human-boundary constraint fails, block stage_sacg_extraction and return the violated constraint to the owning specialist rather than patching it silently.
If a required checker or tool capability is absent, declare planned_tool.<short_name> or planned_checker.<short_name> and require approval before using an unregistered fallback.
Do not treat the absence of detailed rows in this prompt as a missing artifact; verify the actual artifact contents through the checker-backed action before declaring a blocker.
risks: Template library/metadata may be present but not statically bindable to the selected case_adapter and design_space; without template_binding_static_check evidence this would become a downstream SACG extraction blocker.
tool_protocols may omit or misname required checker-verified compile-only VCS roles, causing later verification_artifacts planning to invent capabilities or skip real compile/elaborate/link evidence.

Human-agent boundary may conflict with tool_protocols by allowing auto actions that are not checker-grounded or by forbidding required repair loops; human_boundary_check must resolve this before promotion.

The parallel model, numeric/board, and evidence audits may disagree; aggregating them without checker evidence risks promoting inconsistent shape/numeric/data-order/memory/deployment constraints into SACG.

Historical functional/golden or runtime expectations could be accidentally re-introduced into the readiness gate; acceptance must remain compile-only current-source VCS compilation/elaboration/linking for hardware sources.
If a required checker/tool capability is missing, promotion without a planned_tool.<short_name> or planned_checker.<short_name> declaration would violate the bounded toolchain policy.
output.summary: The toolchain-boundary gate cannot be promoted to ready on the visible evidence. The candidate prepared_inputs slice has empty errors and confirms case_adapter, design_space, field_evidence, field_evidence_candidates, and human_agent_boundary are present; the state summary also lists template_library, template_metadata, tool_protocols, and the parallel specialist audits. However, the detailed checker outcomes for template binding, tool protocol coverage, human-boundary compliance, and merged peer audit consistency are not visible in this prompt, so they remain required handoff evidence. No active SACG-memory blocker is present.
